runtime.note: F09 froze the uint64 analysis seeds but not the library seed-expansion algorithm. F11 binds NumPy PCG64 under an exact NumPy version before producing F11 inferential output. This is a computational reproducibility choice only and does not alter any estimand, sample, hypothesis, delta or failure rule.

primary_bootstrap_t.resampling: For every bootstrap replicate and every scenario, sample 320 whole streams with replacement from that scenario. Checkpoint components remain attached to the stream.
primary_bootstrap_t.H1_H2_standard_error: sqrt(sum_s sample_variance_s/(14^2*320)) using the stream-level contrasts in each scenario
primary_bootstrap_t.H3_standard_error: delta-method linearisation: with theta=Abar/Qbar, z_is=A_is-theta*Q_is, SE=sqrt(sum_s sample_variance_s(z)/(14^2*320*Qbar^2))
primary_bootstrap_t.degenerate_bootstrap_pivot: absolute infinity; never redraw or discard
primary_bootstrap_t.interval: theta_hat +/- critical_value*SE_hat, clipped only to the known contrast support [-1,1]

secondary_sensitivity.purpose: Sensitivity/descriptive analyses only; no addition to the H1-H3 multiplicity family.
secondary_sensitivity.interval: unadjusted 95% stratified stream-cluster percentile interval using the 250th and 9750th one-based sorted bootstrap estimates
analyses: 500-row H1/H2/H3 and H3-ITT on all 4480 streams
5000-row H1/H2/H3 and H3-ITT on the frozen 280-stream contextual subset
RANDOM_RESTART S1 contrasts to PERSIST and RESTART-CART on the frozen 280-stream subset
H3 eligibility rates by scenario and checkpoint
secondary_sensitivity.seed_rule: first 64 bits of SHA-256 over DT-C8E1-F09-v1|CONF|ANALYSIS|<analysis-name>|B=9999; PCG64 as above

mechanism.model: OLS additive no-interaction model with intercept, 13 scenario fixed-effect indicators and the ten F09 predictors
mechanism.standardisation: Full eligible-CONF predictor mean and sample SD, computed without using the outcome; the same scaling is held fixed in bootstrap resamples.
mechanism.zero_variance: retain as all-zero design column and report the coefficient non-estimable
mechanism.bootstrap: Within every scenario resample 320 whole stream clusters with replacement; all eligible checkpoints from a selected stream travel together.
mechanism.bootstrap_rank_rule: Never redraw a bootstrap replicate. If a predictor has exactly zero within-scenario design variation in a replicate, retain its conceptual zero column and mark that coefficient non-estimable for that replicate; estimate the other active predictor columns. If any predictor has fewer than all 9999 finite bootstrap coefficients, report its percentile interval as NOT_ESTIMABLE and report its finite-replicate fraction. This rule is triggered from predictor support only and never from outcome values.
mechanism.uncertainty: unadjusted secondary 95% percentile intervals, 250th and 9750th one-based sorted coefficients when all 9999 coefficients are finite; no mechanism p-values and no causal-mediation language
